status: fresh-seed role-explicit protocol frozen before any v0.8 model call
task_suite: PrefixSum v0.2, adapted from Silo-Bench II-11
task_split: fresh deterministic cases not used in v0.7 audit; all held out under frozen v0.8 protocol
message_transport_adapter: runner override preserves send_message.content as an exact raw string; other parameters use pinned upstream conversion, with out-of-signed-64-bit integers stored as decimal strings to keep JSON logging safe
runtime: llama.cpp b11202, commit fcb3074f2, Windows x64 CUDA 12.4
interaction_scaffold: The private task prompt assigns Agent 0 as the sole sender and Agent 1 as the sole receiver. Agent 0 must send exactly one message addressed to Agent 1 before submitting its own segment. Agent 1 must not send; it must receive Agent 0's message before computing or submitting. Do not target yourself. Each agent submits only its own global prefix sums as a JSON list of integers, in order. Agent 0 computes local cumulative sums; Agent 1 adds Agent 0's exact subtotal to each local cumulative sum (or sums the received full shard first). Do not submit before your assigned send/receive step is complete.

conditions.concise_nl: When Agent 0 sends its single message, communicate only the sum of all values in Agent 0's local segment as one short English sentence exactly of the form `The subtotal is 123.` Replace 123 with the integer sum.
conditions.compact_kv: When Agent 0 sends its single message, encode only the sum of all values in its local segment as s=<integer>, with no other text.
conditions.json_schema: When Agent 0 sends its single message, encode the sum of all values in its local segment as exactly one valid JSON object of the form {"s": 123}. Replace 123 with the sum. Do not use single quotes or add prose.
conditions.binary: When Agent 0 sends its single message, encode only the sum of all values in its local segment as its base-2 digits, without a prefix, leading zeros, or prose. Example: decimal 13 is 1101 in base 2.
conditions.full_shard: When Agent 0 sends its single message, copy its entire local segment as exactly one valid JSON list of integers in original order. Do not calculate or send a subtotal.

intervention_control: no_communication: Silo send_message action disabled; no interaction scaffold injected; role directions remain in task prompts
primary_outcomes: strict per-agent exact prefix-list success and episode-level unanimous success
message direction and action order (Agent 0 sends before submit; Agent 1 receives before submit; Agent 1 does not send)
assigned message grammar syntax and decoded sender-value fidelity
for full_shard, exact JSON list syntax and equality to sender shard
backend-reported input plus output token counts, latency, turns, sends, receives, invalid actions
theory_prediction: For a segment length L with values in {1,...,50}, Agent 1's correct result depends on Agent 0 only through subtotal S. S has 49L+1 possible values, requiring at least ceil(log2(49L+1)) worst-case bits for an exact fixed-length code: 9, 10, and 11 bits for L=6, 15, and 30. If messages preserve their declared payload and role execution succeeds, compact subtotal forms should use fewer bytes than full-shard transfer. This predicts payload size, not model-mediated task success.
limitations: Twelve synthetic two-agent tasks from one algorithmic family do not establish naturalistic collaboration transfer.
One greedy run per episode-condition is exploratory; agent outputs are paired within episodes.
No equal total-token budget is imposed; no efficiency frontier or scaling law will be claimed.
These fresh task seeds are public and are held out only from this frozen protocol, not a permanently secret test set.
Token totals are backend-specific and not comparable with other runtimes.
